AwsConnectionExtraSchema.description:
Extra options for an Amazon S3 (or S3-compatible) connection.

The names match the ones of the Airflow `aws` connection, so an Airflow
connection can be reused as it is.

Attributes:
    base_uri: Explicit base URI (for example `s3://bucket/prefix`). Takes
        precedence over `bucket` and `prefix`.
    bucket: Bucket name used to build the base URI.
    prefix: Optional path inside the bucket, appended to the bucket.
    region_name: AWS region (for example `eu-west-1`).
    endpoint_url: Custom endpoint for S3-compatible stores such as MinIO
        (for example `http://minio:9000`). Switches to path-style requests.
    profile_name: Named profile of the AWS config files to take credentials
        from. A profile that sets `role_arn` and `source_profile` assumes
        that IAM role.
    aws_session_token: Session token that goes with static keys.

base_uri.description: Explicit base URI. Takes precedence over 'bucket' and 'prefix'.
base_uri.title: Base Uri

bucket.description: Bucket name used to build the base URI (s3://bucket).
bucket.title: Bucket

prefix.description: Optional path inside the bucket, appended to the base URI.
prefix.title: Prefix

endpoint_url.description: Custom endpoint for S3-compatible stores, e.g. http://minio:9000.
endpoint_url.title: Endpoint Url

profile_name.description: Profile of the AWS config files to take credentials from. A profile with `role_arn` and `source_profile` assumes that IAM role.
profile_name.title: Profile Name

aws_session_token.description: Session token that goes with static keys (login/password).
aws_session_token.title: Aws Session Token

AwsConnectionExtraSchema.title: AwsConnectionExtraSchema

AwsConnectionSchema.description:
Amazon S3 (or S3-compatible) connection.

Credentials are, in order of preference: IAM roles and the rest of the AWS
credential chain (leave `login` and `password` empty), or static keys in
`login` (access key id) and `password` (secret access key).

Attributes:
    conn_type: Discriminator for this connection type (`"aws"`, or its alias
        `"s3"`).
    extra: S3-specific options.

host.description: Network host or endpoint (e.g., domain name or IP). Leave unset if not applicable.
host.title: Host

login.description: Username or identity used for authentication.
login.title: Login

password.description: Secret or token used for authentication (keep secure).
password.title: Password

conn_type.description: Connection type discriminator: "aws" or its alias "s3".
conn_type.title: Conn Type

AwsConnectionSchema.title: AwsConnectionSchema

CSVEntry.description:
Catalog entry describing a CSV dataset.

Attributes:
    file_format: Literal string identifying the file format: `'csv'`.
    load_options: Options controlling CSV *reading* (see `CSVLoadOptions`).
    save_options: Options controlling CSV *writing* (see `CSVSaveOptions`).

connection.description: Airflow connection ID, or an inline connection validated against the schema selected by its `conn_type`
connection.title: Connection

CSVEntry.title: CSVEntry

CSVLoadOptions.description:
Options that control how CSV files are *read*.

These mirror the DuckDB `read_csv` parameters we expose.
All fields are optional; unset values defer to DuckDB defaults.

Attributes:
    columns: Optional mapping of column names to logical types
        (e.g. {"id": "INTEGER", "amount": "DOUBLE"}) used to override
        DuckDB's type inference when auto-detect is not good enough.
    sep: Field separator (e.g. ",", "|", "\t"). If None, DuckDB will try
        to detect it.
    header: Whether the first row contains column names. If None, DuckDB
        will detect it.
    sample_size: Number of rows to sample for schema detection. If None,
        the DuckDB default applies.
    all_varchar: If True, read all columns as VARCHAR (string). Useful
        when types are messy.

columns.description: Override inferred types per column, e.g. {'id': 'INTEGER'}.
columns.title: Columns

header.description: Whether the first row is a header; auto-detected if None.
header.title: Header

sample_size.description: Rows to sample for inference; DuckDB default if None.
sample_size.title: Sample Size

all_varchar.description: If True, read all columns as VARCHAR.
all_varchar.title: All Varchar

CSVLoadOptions.title: CSVLoadOptions

CSVSaveOptions.description:
Options that control how CSV files are *written*.

Attributes:
    header: Whether to write a header row with column names.
    sep: Field separator to use when writing (e.g. ',', '|', '\t').
    overwrite: If True, allow overwriting existing files at the
        destination. Compression is *inferred from the file extension*
        ('.gz', '.zst', …).

header.description: Write a header row with column names.
header.title: Header

overwrite.description: If True, overwrite existing files at the destination.
overwrite.title: Overwrite

CSVSaveOptions.title: CSVSaveOptions

DeltaTableEntry.description:
Catalog entry describing a Delta Lake table dataset.

This entry specifies configuration for reading from or writing to Delta
Lake tables, typically stored on local or cloud-backed storage. It includes
both connection details and Delta-specific load/save options.

Attributes:
    file_format: Literal string identifying the file format: `'delta_table'`.
    load_options: Optional configuration controlling Delta table *reading*
        behavior (see :class:`DeltaTableLoadOptions`).
    save_options: Optional configuration controlling Delta table *writing*
        behavior (see :class:`DeltaTableSaveOptions`).

connection.description: Airflow connection ID, or an inline connection validated against the schema selected by its `conn_type`
connection.title: Connection

DeltaTableEntry.title: DeltaTableEntry

DeltaTableLoadOptions.description:
Options controlling how a Delta table is read.

Attributes:
  version: Optional table version to read.
  without_files: If True, skip listing data files (metadata-only read).
  log_buffer_size: Buffer size for reading Delta logs.
DeltaTableLoadOptions.title: DeltaTableLoadOptions

DeltaTableSaveOptions.description:
Options controlling how a Delta table is written.

Attributes:
  mode: Write mode to apply if the table exists.
  partition_by: Columns to partition by (Hive-style directory layout).
  schema_mode: Strategy to reconcile schema differences during write.

partition_by.description: Columns to partition by (Hive-style directory layout).
partition_by.title: Partition By

schema_mode.description: How to handle schema differences on write.

DeltaTableSaveOptions.title: DeltaTableSaveOptions

ExcelEntry.description:
Catalog entry describing an Excel dataset.

Attributes:
    file_format: Literal string identifying the file format: `'excel'`.
    load_options: Options controlling Excel *reading* (see `ExcelLoadOptions`).
    save_options: Options controlling Excel *writing* (see `ExcelSaveOptions`).

connection.description: Airflow connection ID, or an inline connection validated against the schema selected by its `conn_type`
connection.title: Connection

ExcelEntry.title: ExcelEntry

ExcelLoadOptions.description:
Options that control how an .xlsx file is read.

Attributes:
  header: If True, treat the first row as column headers.
  sheet: Optional worksheet name to read. If omitted, the first sheet is used.
  range: Excel A1-style range to read (e.g., "A1:D100").
         If omitted, the full sheet is read.
  all_varchar: If True, coerce all columns to VARCHAR (strings).
  empty_as_varchar: If True, treat empty columns as VARCHAR instead of NULL/typed.
ExcelLoadOptions.title: ExcelLoadOptions

ExcelSaveOptions.description:
Options that control how an Arrow table is written to .xlsx.

Attributes:
  header: If True, include column headers in the output file.
  sheet: Optional worksheet name to write into (created if missing).
ExcelSaveOptions.title: ExcelSaveOptions

GoogleCloudPlatformConnectionExtraSchema.description:
Extra options for a Google Cloud Storage-style connection.

Exactly one of the key sources may be provided, depending on how
credentials are supplied.

Attributes:
    keyfile_dict: Service account credentials as a mapping (already-parsed
        JSON). Useful when credentials are injected as structured data.
    keyfile: Service account credentials as a raw JSON string.
    key_path: Filesystem path to a service account key file accessible at
        runtime.
    base_uri: Explicit base URI (for example `gs://bucket/prefix`). Takes
        precedence over `bucket` and `prefix`.
    bucket: Bucket name used to build the base URI.
    prefix: Optional path inside the bucket, appended to the bucket.

base_uri.description: Explicit base URI. Takes precedence over 'bucket' and 'prefix'.
base_uri.title: Base Uri

bucket.description: Bucket name used to build the base URI (gs://bucket).
bucket.title: Bucket

prefix.description: Optional path inside the bucket, appended to the base URI.
prefix.title: Prefix

keyfile_dict.description: Service account credentials as a mapping (parsed JSON). Use when credentials are injected as structured data.
keyfile_dict.title: Keyfile Dict

keyfile.description: Service account credentials as a raw JSON string. Mutually exclusive with 'keyfile_dict' and 'key_path'.
keyfile.title: Keyfile

key_path.description: Path to a service account key file on the local or worker filesystem. Mutually exclusive with 'keyfile_dict' and 'keyfile'.
key_path.title: Key Path

LocalFsConnectionExtraSchema.description:
Extra options for a local filesystem connection.

Both keys are optional. Without either of them, dataset locations are
resolved relative to the current working directory.

Attributes:
    base_path: Base path on the local filesystem used to resolve relative
        dataset or resource paths.
    base_uri: Explicit base URI (for example `file:///data`). Takes
        precedence over `base_path`.

base_path.description: Base path on the local filesystem used to resolve relative dataset or resource paths.
base_path.title: Base Path

base_uri.description: Explicit base URI. Takes precedence over 'base_path'.
base_uri.title: Base Uri

LocalFsConnectionExtraSchema.title: LocalFsConnectionExtraSchema

LocalFsConnectionSchema.description:
Local filesystem connection.

Describes access to data stored on the same machine or mounted volumes.

Attributes:
    conn_type: Constant discriminator for this connection type (`"fs"`).
    extra: Local filesystem-specific configuration (e.g., base path).

host.description: Network host or endpoint (e.g., domain name or IP). Leave unset if not applicable.
host.title: Host

login.description: Username or identity used for authentication.
login.title: Login

password.description: Secret or token used for authentication (keep secure).
password.title: Password

conn_type.description: Connection type discriminator. Always "fs" for local filesystem.
conn_type.title: Conn Type

extra.description: Type-specific options for local filesystem access.

description:
A collection of named datasets with associated loader configuration.

The catalog maps user-defined keys to concrete dataset entries (e.g., CSV or
Excel). It can be constructed from an in-memory dictionary, an Airflow
Variable (JSON), or a YAML file.

Attributes:
    entries: Mapping of dataset names to their configurations.
